summary: Rotary dial that follows the pointer around a 270° arc, flashing a tick and rolling the value at each detent, then springs onto the step.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, snapped to `step` and clamped to `min` and `max`. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value. A `max` below `min` is treated as `min`.

props.name: step
props.description: Detent size, greater than 0 (anything else falls back to 1). Its decimal places set the display precision.

props.name: label
props.description: Caption under the dial and the slider's `aria-label`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every detent change from drag, wheel or keys.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called with each wheel or key step, and when a drag ends, even if the value did not change.

keyboard.action: Change by ten steps, stopping at `max` or `min`.

accessibility: The dial has `role="slider"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and an `aria-label` from `label`.
Pressing on the dial moves focus to it.
The tick marks are `aria-hidden`, as are the min and max labels.
motion: With reduced motion the knob settles on the step angle without overshoot, ticks do not flash, the knob does not nudge and the value swaps without rolling.
notes: Dragging into the 90° gap at the bottom of the arc sticks to the nearer end. The scroll wheel over the dial changes one step per tick and does not scroll the page; sideways scrolling is ignored.
With 16 or fewer detents each step gets a major tick plus two minor ticks; with more, one tick per detent, up to 91 evenly spaced ticks.
Changing `value` from outside springs the knob to it and flashes its tick without calling either callback.
